title: Whole Raised Bag Closer and Empty Platform Scale Preparation Corner
description: One newly authored empty equipment-preparation corner scene, zero new standalone models and one scene. The complete corrected portable open-carry-frame bag closer rests on a broad raised left shelf supported by two full piers, with its whole narrow lower foot, complete case, rear motor, exposed entire thread-cone appearance and open carry frame unchanged. The entire old mechanical platform-beam scale stands separately on the lower right floor, preserving all four ground feet, open base frame, full empty platform, rear column, unequal-arm beam, bored poise and link appearances. A whole low common floor and short rear boundary define a shared open foreground rather than enclosing the apparatus. Every original GLB binary buffer, vertex normal, material dictionary and internal node transformation is retained byte-for-byte; whole-object wrappers perform translation only at exact binary-fraction offsets and unit scale. The two piers meet the shelf on full opposed top faces, and all five original ground soles meet their actual complete supporting faces without sinking. This differs from the older scale/handtruck/sorting-cabinet floor bay and the tall spiral-separator/raised-divider inspection court: one compact complete handheld machine is elevated at left above a two-pier support while the whole low-platform scale remains at right, with no storage cabinet, handtruck, trier, divider or spiral apparatus. No bags, parcel, material transfer, weighing operation, stitches, shared production line, scale calibration, platform capacity, stability, ergonomics, manufacture, food suitability or safety capability is made or verified. No rigging animation physics or interaction.
